Definition: Karkor, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Karkor is where Gideon found the last of the Midianite host: Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor. Their hosts were with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Karkor as the end of the chase, where the pursuit that began at the Jordan finished.
